recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white portrait of a woman where the right side of her face and the background are obscured by a dense, chaotic collage of newspaper-style text and headlines. The left side remains a clean, sharp photographic image, creating a duality between clarity and media noise.
coreVisualRelationships: Duality between clean photographic skin and dense typographic texture
High-contrast lighting separating the subject from the white negative space
Vertical division of the frame through the subject's facial midline
Repetition of text elements to create a rhythmic, chaotic background pattern
coreInvariants: Strict monochrome palette (black, white, and grayscale)
Use of blackletter or gothic display type for the primary title
Newspaper-style column layout for background text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, captured from the chest up, slightly angled to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's left eye (viewer's left) which is clear and in sharp focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the clear eye, moves to the bold title in the upper left, then follows the texture of the text collage down the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy white negative space on the left side to balance the density of the right-side collage.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between pure white and deep black.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Gothic/Blackletter for display; Serif and Sans-Serif for body text
letterConstructionRules: Display type uses heavy strokes with sharp, angular terminals
Body text mimics traditional broadsheet newspaper columns
Text is layered with varying opacities and scales
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'r' in display type features a prominent, sharp ear
Double-story 'a' in display type with a closed counter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of ornate, aggressive blackletter with utilitarian, neutral newsprint serifs.

preserve: Lowercase blackletter for the main title
The contrast between clear skin and text-covered skin
avoid: Modern geometric sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the traditional blackletter aesthetic of the display type
Standard newspaper body text feel for the collage elements
Sharp, aggressive gothic terminals similar to the reference

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with wet-look hair, wearing a gray sweatshirt. The lighting should be harsh from the left, leaving the right side of her face in deep shadow. The background should be pure white on the left and transition into a dense collage of monochromatic newspaper clippings and headlines on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a bold blackletter title in lowercase to the upper left negative space. Add a thin horizontal line directly beneath it. Overlay additional layers of varying serif text across the right half of the image, using a multiply blend mode to ensure the text follows the contours of the subject's face and clothing.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the display text in a blackletter style?
Is the right side of the face covered in text while the left is clear?
Is there a horizontal line under the main title?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distressing on the sweatshirt
mustRedesign: Specific names or brand-identifying words in the collage
Unique facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Sharp photographic clarity on the left
Legible but chaotic typographic texture on the right

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color artifacts are present
Verify the blackletter font is lowercase
Check that the text collage doesn't obscure the left eye
Confirm the horizontal rule is present and aligned
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a clean B&W portrait with a half-frame newspaper collage, anchored by a bold blackletter title in the negative space.
